brief:
Israeli forces killed one Palestinian and injured several others in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident marks the latest in a pattern of armed confrontations in the territory.

Palestinians in the West Bank face escalating Israeli military operations and security measures, according to the report. The extent of injuries and the circumstances surrounding the fatality were not detailed in the initial account.
dek: Palestinians in West Bank are suffering increasing Israeli violence and repression.
title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian in occupied West Bank
